'This counts as a Gold.' + printed Legendary Olympia Specialization / Temper.

SHAPE copied verbatim from shipped hvy/aurum_aegis.json, whose printed text is word-for-word this card's ('<Hero> Specialization / This counts as a Gold / Temper') - only the specialization name differs; three sibling drafts (golden_galea, golden_gauntlets, golden_heart_plate) already carry the identical file. GRANT_SUBTYPE reads 'subtype' (effect_types.py:4381-4393) and appends 'Gold' to card.subtypes so subtype-aware gold checks (CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE family) see the equipment. ON_EQUIP is a real trigger (trigger_types.py:84) dispatched from the start-of-game listener to each equipped card (engine.py:1613-1618) - Golden Gait is Legs equipment that starts the game equipped, so the grant lands; this is the one ON_EQUIP case that is live today (mid-game equips fire nothing, but this card never equips mid-game).

NOTHING ELSE AUTHORED: Legendary, Specialization and Temper are all in printed_keywords and fire from the card DB keywords field - re-authoring them would be a defect. The card has no other functional text.

SET FOLDER AT ADOPTION: SuperSlam -> json/sup/ (SUP250).
